arguments.content:
# Decisions, January to March 2026

| Decision | Owner | Date |
|---|---|---|
| Decided: the launch moves to 14 April. | Dana | 2026-01-08 |
| We reversed the Postgres decision of 15 January: we stay on MySQL this year. | Ken | 2026-02-12 |
| We agreed that Lena redesigns the pricing page. | Lena | 2026-01-15 |
| Decision: on-call rotates weekly, starting with Omar. | Omar | 2026-01-22 |
| Outcome: the beta is limited to 50 customers; Dana picks them. | Dana | 2026-01-29 |
| Final call: Brisa becomes our payment provider; Ken owns the contract. | Ken | 2026-02-05 |
| Decided: we hire two engineers this quarter; Priya leads the hiring. | Priya | 2026-02-05 |
| We agreed to keep the current logo; Lena tells the agency. | Lena | 2026-02-12 |
| Decision: single sign-on (SSO) ships in Q2; Omar owns it. | Omar | 2026-02-19 |
| Outcome: the travel budget is cut by 20 %; Priya informs the teams. | Priya | 2026-02-26 |
| Decided: the docs site moves to the new generator; Lena owns the move. | Lena | 2026-03-05 |
| We agreed on a code freeze one week before launch; Omar enforces it. | Omar | 2026-03-05 |
| Final call: support hours extend to 8 pm; Dana staffs the shifts. | Dana | 2026-03-12 |
| Decision: we drop the old analytics tool by April; Ken removes it. | Ken | 2026-03-19 |
| Decided: the team offsite is in May; Priya books it. | Priya | 2026-03-26 |

## Open questions

- How long do we keep customer data (the retention period)?
- Who owns the mobile app after the reorganisation?
- Which old browsers do we still support?
- Is there budget for the autumn conference?
- Which translation vendor do we use for the German site?
